mapper.sql: select a.id, a.bill_id, b.bill_no, a.usage_id, a.diff_type, a.diff_desc, a.supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, a.customer_id, cu.name as customer_name, a.call_no, a.call_time, a.amount, a.handle_status, a.handle_remark, a.handler, h.user_name as handler_name, a.handle_time, a.create_time from crm_contract_bill_diff a left join crm_contract_bill b on a.bill_id = b.id left join crm_supplier s on a.supplier_id = s.id left join crm_customer cu on a.customer_id = cu.id left join sys_user h on a.handler = h.user_id
mapper.select: select id, bill_id, usage_id, diff_type, diff_desc, supplier_id, customer_id, call_no, call_time, amount, handle_status, handle_remark, handler, handle_time, create_time from crm_contract_bill_diff where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into crm_contract_bill_diff ( bill_id, usage_id, diff_type, diff_desc, supplier_id, customer_id, call_no, call_time, amount, handle_status, handle_remark, handler, handle_time, create_time ) values ( #{billId}, #{usageId}, #{diffType}, #{diffDesc}, #{supplierId}, #{customerId}, #{callNo}, #{callTime}, #{amount}, ifnull(#{handleStatus}, 0), #{handleRemark}, #{handler}, #{handleTime}, ifnull(#{createTime}, sysdate()) )
